title: Successful Android restore loses named filter selections and their schedules
reproduction: Create a named set with a daily schedule in the signed app. Back up with Android local transport, clear app data and restore the same package.
expected: Restore the saved selection, chosen URLs, profile identity and schedules without restoring cached lists or transport permissions.
observed: Android reported success; the schedule went from one scheduled set to Off. The debug baseline also lost the exact saved URL membership.
fix: Register the two filter preference stores under an additional stable helper key and reconcile periodic work against the restored configuration.
test_evidence: Signed public-to-local upgrade and fresh restore: disabled and enabled sources, named set and schedule survived; restored user block and independent positive DNS control verified. Extended debug test also verified weekly day, time, per-URL schedule and redirect consent. See deep-signoff/platform-restore.md.
